situations.title: VTE 위험 평가·예방
situations.tagline: Let's assess his VTE risk and set up the right prophylaxis.
situations.brief: 기계적과 약물 예방을 계획하며 VTE 위험을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: He's high risk, so we'll combine mechanical and chemical prophylaxis.
Sequential compression devices are on and cycling.
I'll confirm the chemical prophylaxis order and any contraindications.

situations.title: 욕창 위험 사정
situations.tagline: Let's score her Braden so we know her pressure-injury risk.
situations.brief: Braden 위험 등급으로 욕창 위험을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Her Braden score puts her at high risk.
Low mobility and moisture are her biggest factors.
I'll start a prevention bundle based on the score.

situations.title: 체위변경·압력 재분산
situations.tagline: It's time to turn him — let's keep to the two-hour schedule.
situations.brief: turning schedule를 지켜 체위변경과 압력 재분산을 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's turn him and offload the pressure points.
I'll use pillows to keep his heels off the bed.
Next turn is due in two hours — I'll log it.

situations.title: 조기 이동 스크리닝
situations.tagline: Let's screen whether she's ready to start mobilizing today.
situations.brief: mobility 적합성을 확인하며 조기 이동을 스크리닝하세요.
keyPhrases: Her oxygenation and hemodynamics meet the mobility criteria.
She's following commands and her lines are secure.
Let's start with sitting at the edge of the bed.

situations.title: 피부·압박점 사정
situations.tagline: Let's inspect every pressure point and catch any early skin changes.
situations.brief: 조기 발견을 위해 피부와 압박점을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm checking the sacrum, heels, and elbows for redness.
This area doesn't blanch — it may be a stage-one injury.
I'll document and offload the pressure right away.

situations.title: 수동 관절운동
situations.tagline: Let's do his passive range-of-motion so his joints don't stiffen.
situations.brief: ROM 유지를 위해 수동 관절운동을 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll take each joint gently through its full range.
I'll stop if he shows pain or resistance.
This helps prevent contractures while he's immobile.

situations.title: 인공호흡 환자 조기 이동
situations.tagline: He's vented but stable — let's mobilize him safely with all these lines.
situations.brief: 라인 안전 이동을 지키며 인공호흡 환자의 조기 이동을 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll need enough hands to manage the vent and every line.
I'll assign one person to guard the airway.
We stop immediately if his sats or pressure drop.

situations.title: 낙상 위험 관리
situations.tagline: She's weak and unsteady — how do we keep her safe as she starts moving?
situations.brief: 이동 중 안전을 위해 낙상 위험을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: She's a high fall risk, so we'll use a gait belt and two staff.
I'll clear the path and lock the wheels first.
We'll sit her down at the first sign of dizziness.

situations.title: 욕창 단계별 관리
situations.tagline: This wound has opened up — let's stage it and pick the right dressing.
situations.brief: staging과 드레싱을 근거로 욕창을 단계별로 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: This looks like a stage-two injury with partial-thickness loss.
I'll choose a dressing that keeps the wound bed moist.
I'll offload the area and reassess with each change.

situations.title: 의료기기 관련 욕창 예방
situations.tagline: Check under his oxygen tubing and collar — devices cause pressure injuries too.
situations.brief: device-related 손상을 예방하기 위해 의료기기 아래 피부를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll check the skin under every device on a schedule.
I'll cushion the tubing and rotate its position.
The collar and mask edges are common pressure points.

situations.title: VTE 예방 금기·조정
situations.tagline: He's got a bleeding risk — can we still give chemical prophylaxis or not?
situations.brief: 출혈 위험 균형을 고려해 VTE 예방의 금기와 조정을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: With his bleeding risk, chemical prophylaxis is contraindicated for now.
We'll rely on mechanical prophylaxis instead.
I'll reassess when his bleeding risk improves.

situations.title: 재활팀 협업 계획
situations.tagline: Let's coordinate with PT and OT on a mobility plan for the week.
situations.brief: PT와 OT 연계로 재활팀 협업 계획을 세우세요.
keyPhrases: PT will progress his mobility and OT will work on function.
Let's set shared goals and schedule sessions.
I'll update you on his tolerance each day.

situations.title: ICU 획득 쇠약 예방
situations.tagline: She's been down a while — let's prevent ICU-acquired weakness before it sets in.
situations.brief: ICU-AW를 예방하기 위해 조기 활동과 재활을 계획하세요.
keyPhrases: Early mobility helps prevent ICU-acquired weakness.
We'll minimize deep sedation to keep her participating.
Daily activity and range of motion are key.

situations.title: 점진적 좌위·의자 이동
situations.tagline: Let's progress her from sitting up to the chair, step by step.
situations.brief: progressive mobility 원칙으로 점진적 좌위와 의자 이동을 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: First we'll sit her at the edge and check her tolerance.
If she stays stable, we'll transfer her to the chair.
I'm watching her vitals and how she's feeling at each step.

situations.title: 영양·피부 통합 관리
situations.tagline: His wounds won't heal without nutrition — let's tie the two plans together.
situations.brief: 치유 지원을 위해 영양과 피부 관리를 통합하세요.
keyPhrases: Adequate protein and calories support wound healing.
I'll coordinate with the dietitian on his targets.
Good nutrition and offloading work together.
goals: 영양 상태와 창상 치유를 연결해 관리한다

situations.title: 심부 욕창·감염 위기
situations.tagline: This wound has gone deep and now it's foul and warm — I think it's infected!
situations.brief: 창상 악화에 대응하기 위해 심부 욕창과 감염 위기를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: The wound is deep with foul drainage — this looks infected.
I'm escalating to the provider and the wound team now.
We may need debridement and cultures.

situations.title: 조기 이동 중 급성 악화
situations.tagline: Her sats just dropped as she stood — sit her back down, now!
situations.brief: desaturation 시 중단과 복귀로 조기 이동 중 급성 악화에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Her sats are dropping — we're stopping and sitting her down.
Get her back to bed and increase her oxygen.
I'm rechecking her full set of vitals.
goals: 이동 중 급성 악화를 인지하고 즉시 중단한다

situations.title: 이동 중 낙상·손상 위기
situations.tagline: She's going down — ease her to the floor and don't let her head hit!
situations.brief: 사고 대응을 위해 이동 중 낙상과 손상 위기에 대처하세요.
keyPhrases: Ease her down and protect her head.
Don't move her until I check for injury.
I'll call for help and assess her from head to toe.

situations.title: 급성 폐색전 발생 위기
situations.tagline: He's suddenly gasping with chest pain and his sats crashed — could this be a PE?
situations.brief: 인지와 에스컬레이션으로 급성 폐색전 발생 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Sudden dyspnea, chest pain, and hypoxia — I'm worried about a PE.
I'm giving high-flow oxygen and calling the rapid response.
We need imaging and the provider at the bedside now.

situations.title: 이동 중 라인·튜브 이탈 위기
situations.tagline: A line got yanked in the transfer — hold pressure and check what came out!
situations.brief: 재확보를 위해 이동 중 라인과 튜브 이탈 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The central line pulled — I'm holding firm pressure now.
Check whether the drain or the feeding tube dislodged.
Call the provider so we can re-secure access.
goals: 이동 중 라인 이탈을 인지하고 지혈한다

situations.title: 다발성 욕창·불응 목표 소통
situations.tagline: His wounds keep spreading despite everything — can we talk about what's realistic for him?
situations.brief: 예후와 자원을 고려해 다발성 욕창과 불응 상태의 치료 목표를 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Despite our best care, the wounds keep progressing.
I want to talk honestly about his overall condition.
Let's focus on his comfort and dignity together.
